title: Remote Access | Protection of Confidentiality / Integrity Using Encryption
description: The information system implements cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality and integrity of remote access sessions. SSH v2 is required.

title: Remote Access | Automated Monitoring / Control
description: Telnet provides no encryption and must be disabled. All remote access must use SSH.
remediation: Disable: no service telnet / transport input ssh on all VTY lines

title: Account Management | Inactivity Logout
description: The system must automatically terminate sessions after a defined period of inactivity (≤10 min).
remediation: Configure: exec-timeout 10 0 on all VTY and console lines

title: Device Identification and Authentication
description: AAA must be enabled so that all users authenticate before accessing device management functions.

title: Authenticator Management | Password-Based Authentication
description: Passwords must be stored using a strong one-way hashing algorithm. Enable secret (type-5+) required.

title: Authenticator Management | No Embedded Unencrypted Static Authenticators
description: Service password-encryption must be enabled to prevent cleartext passwords in configuration.

title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
description: The HTTP cleartext management interface must be disabled. HTTPS or out-of-band only.

title: Information Management and Retention — SNMP
description: SNMP community strings 'public' and 'private' are well-known defaults and must not be used.
remediation: Remove: no snmp-server community public RO

title: Audit Events
description: The organization must determine events to be audited. Remote syslog must be configured.
remediation: Configure: logging host <SYSLOG_IP> / logging trap informational

title: Time Stamps
description: NTP must be configured so that audit log timestamps are accurate and consistent.

title: Protection of Audit Information
description: NTP must use cryptographic authentication to prevent log timestamp manipulation.

title: Denial of Service Protection
description: BGP MD5 authentication must be configured to prevent route injection attacks.
